subject: src/tensorlbm/contact_angle_inversion/ (m18090 deliverable; m22445 holdout round)
why: m18090 reported 1.09-2.57% errors at one configuration; m22445 re-ran the same inversion on the production grid and got 11.03% at theta=90, attributing the loss to resolution transfer.
m22445's own Arm A (theta=90, calibrated grid, no transfer at all) already missed by 7.71%, which means a term other than resolution was active and was never separated out.
The angle operator every calibration number depends on (contact_angle_from_mask) has never been measured against a known angle, so there is no measured floor under any quoted error.
Both rounds quote total errors only; no error budget exists.

claims_under_test.C1: The delivered inversion's residual error is dominated by Huang2007/resolution transfer.
claims_under_test.C2: contact_angle_from_mask is an accurate angle measurement (bias small compared with the 15% gate).
claims_under_test.C3: Piecewise-linear interpolation between the 7 delivered calibration nodes is adequate.

gates.G1_estimator: For every synthetic cap the estimator accepts (status ok), |theta_meas - theta_true| / theta_true must be < 15%. Points the estimator rejects are reported as NOT_MEASURED, never as passes; the measurable theta band per radius is reported.
gates.G2_interpolation: Leave-one-out chord error of the DELIVERED 7-node curve (cos space, as shipped) must be < 15% on the nodes it covers.
gates.G3_transfer_share: With the w f_w held fixed, the difference between the coarse and the production-grid measurement gives the transfer term; the budget must state the interpolation and transfer shares of the total 11.03% theta=90 error rather than attributing the whole error to one mechanism.
gates.G4_fix: End-to-end hold-out at theta=90 and theta=105 using the refined curve: each row must be inside 15%; whether it reaches 3% is reported, not gated (measurement floor may forbid it).
gates.measurability: a row whose estimator returns status != ok, or whose tail drift > 1 deg, is NOT_MEASURED and excluded from pass counts.

honesty_rules: synthetic ground truth is analytic, no LBM physics involved: bias measured there is estimator-only
every table in REPORT.md is rendered from evidence/*.json, no hand-copied numbers
a variant that loses is reported (delivered vs refined, linear vs pchip), not dropped
the previously claimed C1/C3, if contradicted, is stated as contradicted in the report
